ei.title: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass...
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was (A)[counterbalanced / destabilized] by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more (B)[slender / bulky] towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were (C)[expanded / reduced], the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 짧은 몸통이 긴 꼬리에 의해 '균형을 이뤘다'. 다리 끝이 더 '가늘수록' 움직이기 쉽다. 팔은 달리기에 필요 없어져 '축소되었다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① counterbalanced — slender — reduced: 원문 일치
❌ ② destabilized(불안정하게 하다)는 원문 counterbalanced(균형을 이루다)의 반의어
❌ ③ bulky(부피가 큰)는 원문 slender(가느다란)의 반의어
❌ ④ expanded(확대된)는 원문 reduced(축소된)의 반의어

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it (A)[inevitable / hard] for them to stand (B)[comfortably / uncomfortably] upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and (C)[thin / thick]. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 네발 동물이 오래 서 있기가 '어렵다'. 공룡은 '편안하게' 서 있을 수 있다 (대조). 뒷다리를 '가늘게' 키울 수 있었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① inevitable(불가피한)은 원문 hard(어려운)와 의미 불일치
❌ ② uncomfortably(불편하게)는 원문 comfortably(편안하게)의 반의어
✅ ③ hard — comfortably — thin: 원문 일치
❌ ④ thick(두꺼운)은 원문 thin(가느다란)의 반의어

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A (A)[absolutely / relatively] short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without (B)[difficulty / effort]. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as (C)[grasping / releasing] prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 엉덩이 앞의 '비교적' 짧은 몸통. 힘 '들이지 않고' 뒷다리로 설 수 있었다. 먹이를 '움켜쥐는' 활동.
det.analysis:
✅ ① relatively — effort — grasping: 원문 일치
❌ ② absolutely(절대적으로)는 원문 relatively(비교적)와 의미 불일치
❌ ③ difficulty(어려움)는 문맥상 'without effort'(노력 없이)와 다른 의미축 (without difficulty도 가능하나 원문은 effort)
❌ ④ releasing(놓는)은 원문 grasping(움켜쥐는)의 반의어

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of ①<u>energy</u> for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably ②<u>upright</u> for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, ③<u>flexible</u> tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left ④<u>free</u> for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 stiff(뻣뻣한)인데 flexible(유연한)로 교체. 긴 '뻣뻣한' 꼬리가 균형추 역할을 한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① energy(에너지): 뒷다리로 일어서는 데 많은 에너지가 든다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② upright(똑바로): 편안하게 '똑바로' 서 있기 어렵다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ flexible(유연한) → stiff(뻣뻣한): 균형추 역할을 하려면 꼬리가 '뻣뻣해야' 하므로 flexible은 부적절
✅ ④ free(자유로운): 손이 다른 활동을 위해 '자유롭게' 남겨졌다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their ①<u>hindlimbs</u>. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively ②<u>elongated</u> body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are ③<u>easier</u> to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or ④<u>climbing</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 short(짧은)인데 elongated(길어진)로 교체. 대부분의 양막류의 '짧고' 두꺼운 사지라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① elongated(길어진) → short(짧은): 대부분의 양막류(amniotes)는 '짧고' 두꺼운 사지를 가지는데, 공룡은 이와 달리 길고 가는 뒷다리를 가졌다는 대조 문맥. elongated는 부적절
✅ ② hindlimbs(뒷다리): 공룡이 뒷다리로 서 있을 수 있었다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ easier(더 쉬운): 다리가 가늘수록 움직이기 '더 쉽다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ climbing(오르기): 먹이 잡기나 '오르기' 같은 다른 활동이라는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by ①<u>contrast</u>, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a ②<u>long</u>, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run ③<u>fast</u>. The arms, no longer required for running, were ④<u>enhanced</u>, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 reduced(축소된)인데 enhanced(강화된)로 교체. 달리기에 더 이상 필요 없어져 팔이 '축소되었다'는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① contrast(대조): 공룡은 '이에 반해' 질량 중심이 엉덩이에 있다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② long(긴): 긴 뻣뻣한 꼬리가 균형추 역할을 한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ fast(빨리): 다리를 쉽게 움직이면 '빨리' 달리기 쉽다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ enhanced(강화된) → reduced(축소된): 달리기에 필요 없어져 팔이 '축소'되었다는 문맥이므로 enhanced는 부적절

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the __________ region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가슴(chest). 대부분의 네발 동물은 '가슴' 부위에 질량 중심이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① chest(가슴): 네발 동물의 질량 중심이 '가슴' 부위에 있다는 원문에 부합
❌ ② tail(꼬리): 꼬리는 공룡의 균형추 역할로 질량 중심 위치와 무관
❌ ③ hindlimbs(뒷다리): 뒷다리는 서는 부위이지 질량 중심이 아님
❌ ④ hips(엉덩이): 엉덩이는 공룡의 질량 중심으로, 네발 동물과 대조됨
det.tip: chest = 가슴 부위 (대부분의 네발 동물의 질량 중심 위치)

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was __________ by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 균형을 이루다(counterbalanced). 엉덩이 앞의 짧은 몸통이 긴 꼬리에 의해 '균형을 이뤘다'.
det.analysis:
❌ ① hindlimbs(뒷다리): 관련 있으나 빈칸 문맥의 균형/상쇄 의미와 불일치

❌ ② slender(가늘어지는): 다리 형태 관련이나 균형/상쇄 의미와 불일치

❌ ③ comfortably(편안하게): 직립 관련이나 명사가 아닌 부사로 문법적 부적절

✅ ④ counterbalance(상쇄하다): 짧은 몸이 긴 꼬리에 의해 상쇄/균형을 이룬다는 문맥에 부합
det.tip: counterbalance = 균형을 이루다 (counter- 반대로 + balance 균형)

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more __________ towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가느다란(slender). 다리 끝이 더 '가늘수록' 움직이기 쉽다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① upright(똑바로): 앞 문장에서 서 있는 자세를 설명하는 단어로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
❌ ② reduced(축소된): 마지막 문장에서 팔 축소를 설명하는 단어로 위치 불일치
❌ ③ required(필요한): 마지막 문장에서 달리기에 필요하다는 맥락으로 위치 불일치
✅ ④ slender(가느다란): 다리 끝이 더 '가늘수록' 움직이기 쉽다는 문맥에 부합

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>counterbalanced</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: counterbalanced = offset = 상쇄하다, 균형을 맞추다
det.analysis:
✅ ① offset(상쇄하다): counterbalanced의 동의어로 가장 적절
❌ ② disrupted(방해하다): 균형을 깨뜨리는 것으로 반의어에 가까움
❌ ③ diminished(줄어들다): 의미축 다름 (크기 감소)
❌ ④ intensified(강화하다): 의미축 다름 (강도 증가)
det.tip: counterbalance = offset = compensate = 상쇄하다, 균형을 맞추다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>slender</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: slender = slim = 가느다란, 날씬한
det.analysis:
❌ ① sturdy(튼튼한): slender의 반의어에 가까움
✅ ② slim(가느다란): slender의 동의어로 가장 적절
❌ ③ rigid(단단한): 형태가 아닌 질감/유연성의 의미축
❌ ④ massive(거대한): slender의 반의어에 가까움

det.korean: reduced = diminished = 축소된, 줄어든
det.analysis:

❌ ② strengthened(강화된): 의미축 다름 (힘의 증가)
✅ ③ diminished(줄어든): reduced의 동의어로 가장 적절
❌ ④ liberated(해방된): 의미축 다름 (자유)

det.analysis:

✅ ② flexible(유연한): stiff(뻣뻣한)의 정확한 반의어
❌ ③ sturdy(튼튼한): 의미축 다름 (강도)
❌ ④ dense(밀도 높은): 의미축 다름 (밀도)

❌ ④ partially(부분적으로): 의미축 다름 (전체 vs 부분)

questions.passage:
(A) The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to <u>run</u> fast. Long, slender limbs gave dinosaurs a clear advantage in speed.

(B) The company decided to <u>run</u> a series of experiments to test the durability of the new material under extreme conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 run의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) run = 달리다(물리적 이동), (B) run = 실시하다(실험을 수행)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 달리다 — (B) 실시하다: (A)는 공룡의 물리적 '달리기', (B)는 실험을 '실시하다'라는 추상적 의미
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B) '작동하다'는 기계 맥락이지 실험 수행과 불일치
❌ ④ (A) '운영하다'는 사업 맥락이지 물리적 달리기와 불일치

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the point at which a lever is placed to get support for moving or lifting something"

det.korean: fulcrum = 받침점, 지렛대의 지지점
det.analysis:
❌ ① hindlimb(뒷다리): 사지의 한 종류이지 지렛대 지지점이 아님
❌ ② contrast(대조): 비교의 개념이지 물리적 지지점이 아님
✅ ③ fulcrum(받침점): 지렛대를 움직이기 위한 지지점이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ④ creature(생물): 생명체를 뜻하지 지지점이 아님

questions.passage: It takes a lot of energy for them to lever __________ (they) upwards onto their hindlimbs.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

they → ____

det.korean: 주어(them=they)와 목적어가 같으므로 재귀대명사 themselves 필요.
det.analysis: to lever themselves upwards — 주어(them=they)가 '자기 자신을' 들어올리는 재귀 동작. they의 재귀대명사 = themselves.

questions.passage: The arms, no longer __________ (require) for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

require → ____

det.korean: 팔이 달리기를 위해 '필요하게 되는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 required.
det.analysis: The arms, no longer required for running — 팔이 달리기를 위해 더 이상 '필요하지 않은' 수동 관계. require → required (과거분사). be required for = ~를 위해 필요하다.
det.tip: be required for = ~를 위해 필요하다 (수동태 → 과거분사 p.p.)

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes __________ for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 에너지(a lot of energy). 뒷다리로 일어서는 데 '많은 에너지'가 든다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② a lot of energy(많은 에너지): It takes ___ for them to lever themselves upwards — 네발 동물이 뒷다리로 일어서는 데 '많은 에너지가 든다'는 문맥에 부합
❌ ① the centre of mass(질량 중심): 앞 문장의 주어로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
❌ ③ their hindlimbs(뒷다리): 같은 문장에서 onto their hindlimbs로 이미 사용
❌ ④ other activities(다른 활동): 마지막 문장의 내용으로 위치 불일치
det.tip: It takes + (비용/에너지) + to V = ~하는 데 (비용/에너지)가 든다

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand __________. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '힘 들이지 않고 뒷다리로' 설 수 있었다. 엉덩이가 받침점 역할을 하여 공룡이 쉽게 서 있을 수 있었다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① on their hindlimbs without effort(힘 들이지 않고 뒷다리로): With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand ___. 받침점으로서의 엉덩이 덕에 공룡이 쉽게 뒷다리로 설 수 있었다는 문맥에 부합
❌ ② with short, thick limbs(짧고 두꺼운 사지로): 이것은 대부분의 양막류 특성으로 공룡과 대조됨
❌ ③ in the chest region(가슴 부위에): 네발 동물의 질량 중심 위치로 위치 불일치
❌ ④ for any length of time(얼마 동안이든): 네발 동물이 서 있기 어려운 시간 문맥으로 공룡의 능력과 불일치
